response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong software development skills and a breadth of experience across web, mobile, and embedded systems, but his background lacks direct alignment with the Principal Performance Architect role's core focus on SoC/IP modeling, AI accelerator optimization, and hardware-software co-design. His expertise in performance optimization and low-latency systems is a positive, but the role's specialized requirements in AI workloads and hardware architecture are not clearly addressed.
strengths: Extensive experience in performance-sensitive systems (e.g., low-latency apps at Sociomantic, real-time data processing).
Diverse technical stack including Dlang, C/C++, and Node.js, with exposure to hardware-software integration (e.g., robotic arms at Altom).
Strong problem-solving and knowledge-sharing mindset, evidenced by workshops, open-source contributions, and testing frameworks.
concerns: No explicit experience with SoC/IP modeling, AI accelerator optimization, or deep-learning workload analysis (key requirements).
Career focus has been on full-stack/web development and tooling, not hardware infrastructure or cloud-scale AI systems.
Lacks advanced degrees (PhD/Master's) or equivalent professional experience in the specific domain of AI/hardware optimization.
